body:
## Problem

TypeScript is configured with basic strict mode but lacks compile-time guarantees for runtime-validated data. Every external boundary (API request, DB query result, WebSocket message, config file) is typed as loose primitives. This means a malformed response from an oracle source or a corrupted JSON file can propagate as invalid types through the entire system, surfacing only as runtime errors far from the root cause.

## Requirements

- **Branded types for all external boundaries** — Create branded/flavor types using intersection types for every external data source (oracle API responses, database rows, WebSocket frames, environment variables). Each boundary must parse and validate with Zod, producing a branded type that TS enforces through the rest of the pipeline.
- **io-ts/Zod integration layer** — Build a runtime type-checking bridge that compiles Zod schemas to TypeScript branded types. Any data entering the system from outside must pass through this bridge. Attempting to pass raw `any` or unvalidated data past a boundary must be a compile-time error.
- **Phantom type support for units** — Prices, timestamps, decimals, and percentages must use phantom type parameters to prevent arithmetic across incompatible units (e.g., adding a USD price to a timestamp must be a type error).
- **Type-level state machines for WebSocket connections** — Model WebSocket connection states (disconnected, connecting, subscribed, backfilling, live) as a type-level state machine. Invalid transitions (e.g., sending a subscription before connection is established) must be compile-time errors.
- **Readonly deep types for all domain models** — All domain models must be `DeepReadonly` by default. Mutation requires explicit opt-in with a `Mutable<T>` wrapper.
- **noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes + noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters + noImplicitReturns** — All strict flags enabled.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Branded/flavor types implemented for all external data boundaries
- [ ] Zod-to-branded-type bridge compiles schemas to runtime + compile-time types
- [ ] Phantom types for price, timestamp, decimal, percent prevent invalid arithmetic
- [ ] WebSocket connection state machine as type-level enum with transition matrix
- [ ] DeepReadonly applied to all domain models by default
- [ ] All 5 strict TS flags enabled, zero escape hatches (`any`, `as`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`)
- [ ] CI enforces strict flags and branded type usage via ESLint plugin
- [ ] Negative tests: PRs that try to pass raw data through a boundary without validation are rejected at type-check time
title: Migrate to strict TypeScript with branded types, phantom types, and type-level state machines
